name: filter_collections
description: Builds an ArrayList and a HashMap per document. Allocation and boxing dominate, and this is the template most sensitive to GC pressure.

script.source: List l = new ArrayList(); for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) { l.add(i); } Map m = new HashMap(); m.put('n', l.size()); return ((int) m.get('n')) >= 0;
